usage: Intravenous pain and fever relief post-surgery or during acute illness.
billing_alert: Hospitals frequently bill ₹200 to ₹350 for Paracetamol IV. NPPA ceiling is ~₹40.50 + GST.

usage: Prevents stress ulcers and acidity in admitted patients.
billing_alert: Administered to almost every admitted patient daily; hospitals inflate price up to 5x.

usage: Broad-spectrum antibiotic for bacterial infections, pneumonia, and surgical prophylaxis.
billing_alert: Commonly billed with separate reconstitution and syringe charges.

usage: Heavy-duty antibiotic used in ICU for severe sepsis or resistant infections.
billing_alert: High-value injection given multiple times a day; check that doses billed match the nurse administration chart.

usage: Prevents blood clots (DVT) after major surgery or in immobile ICU patients.
billing_alert: NPPA ceiling applies to branded pre-filled syringes.

usage: Routine intravenous hydration and medication diluent.
billing_alert: Hospitals often bill multiple bottles daily at ₹100-₹150 each plus separate IV set fees.

usage: Prevents vomiting and nausea caused by surgery or chemotherapy.
billing_alert: Very cheap generic drug frequently marked up 6x-7x on hospital invoices.

usage: Controls high blood sugar in diabetic inpatients.
billing_alert: Hospitals sometimes charge full vial price per single injection dose.
